title: sphenopholis intermedia
intro: Sphenopholis intermedia, commonly known as Beakgrain or Beak Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is native to North America and is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as soothing inflammation, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sphenopholis intermedia include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Sphenopholis intermedia also exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
